name: mage2kishan/module-xml-sitemap
description: Panth XML Sitemap — sharded XML sitemap generator for Magento 2: per-store profile CRUD, product/category/CMS/landing-page/blog/video/image/additional-link contributors, hreflang tags, image + video tags, auto-split at 50,000 URLs or 50 MB, optional gzip compression, changefreq and priority, XSL stylesheet, delta tracking, async shard queue, per-profile cron schedules, CLI generator. Hyva and Luma compatible. Extracted from Panth_AdvancedSEO.

suggest.hyva-themes/magento2-default-theme: For Hyva frontend compatibility (no jQuery, TailwindCSS, AlpineJS).
suggest.mage2kishan/module-blog: Adds Panth blog posts, categories, tags and authors to the XML sitemap
suggest.mage2kishan/module-hreflang: Source of hreflang alternates when Use Panth Hreflang Module is on
suggest.mage2kishan/module-structured-data: Adds detected landing pages to the XML sitemap
